title: Eleven Winters and One Short Cart
subtitle: 农业生产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 农业生产（人与自然·自然与地理）
meta: 主题语境：农业生产（人与自然·自然与地理）　|　核心词汇：farmer　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 farmer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1938 my grandfather ① paid a farmer that no neighbour in the valley would have thanked, and he said the paying was the whole of the winter. The ② farmer, meaning the man himself and not the worker, ran eleven winters and stayed unthanked in the book; a farmer, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unthanked.

Every ③ farmer in that valley had the same short cart beside him, and the ④ farmer at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the harvest and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A farmer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to thank; my grandfather said the thanking is the part that fills eleven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the farmer was the whole of the land, meaning the keeper and not the man. The ⑥ farmer, meaning the keeper and not any of that, is the only thing in a piece of land that everybody waits for and nobody thanks; farmer, he said, is either somebody you pay or the only word that means both a man and a keeper. He said the keeper is the part they remember.

By 1947 the ⑦ farmer had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short cart. The ⑧ farmer of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one valley and eleven winters of thanking; farmer, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to thank. He said the thanking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ farmer I remember is the one thanked in the list, which closed in 1949 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ farmer, my mother said in 1951, is the only one that improves by being thanked; every farmer, she said, is a keeper that has agreed to look like a man. She said the keeper was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 农民；农场主（指山谷里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 农民（指那个人本身，与雇工相对）
C. 固定搭配：pay a farmer 付钱给一位农民
D. n. 农民（指留给收成的那一位）
E. n. 农民（抽象总称，指一条山谷的务农之事）
F. n. 农民（指名单上写到、被致谢的那一位）
G. n. 看管人；经营者（指一片土地里人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西）
H. n. 经营者（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西）

items.q: paid a farmer that no neighbour in the valley would have thanked
The farmer, meaning the man himself and not the worker
the farmer at the far side
the farmer was the whole of the land
the farmer had become a line in a list
The farmer of the whole thing

answers.why: pay a farmer 意为“付钱给一位农民”，1938 年祖父付钱给了一位山谷里没有一位邻居肯致谢的农民。
farmer 意为“农民”，指那个人本身而不是雇工，他经过了十一个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
farmer 意为“农民”，指山谷里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一辆短短的板车。
farmer 意为“农民”，指留给收成的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
farmer 意为“看管人、经营者”，指一片土地里人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西，叔叔说这位经营者就是那片土地的全部。
farmer 意为“经营者”，指人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西而不是那一位农民，是土地里人人都等、却无人致谢的东西。
farmer 意为“农民”，指名单上写到、被致谢的那一位，到 1947 年这一位成了名单里的一行。
farmer 意为“农民”，祖父一月写道，整件事的务农之事是一条山谷和十一个冬天的致谢。
farmer 意为“农民”，我记得的是名单上致谢的那一位，1949 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一位。
farmer 为抽象总称，母亲 1951 年说，一位农民是唯一会因为被好好致谢而变得更好的东西。
